institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific thank you messages to the lender community tend to fund faster.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years the business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the duration of business operation tend to accelerate funding speed for both men and women.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

living-conditions-interaction.title: Mentioning home or living condition improvements accelerates funding for women but slows it for men.
living-conditions-interaction.body: Pitches from women that focus on improving living conditions fund faster, whereas similar mentions in male pitches predict slower funding.

female-tireless-dream-faster.body: The phrase 'working tirelessly toward the attainment of her dream' may accelerate funding for women, contrasting with general mentions of dreams.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Mentioning specific loan amounts in local currency may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-education-hybrid-faster.body: Linking education expenses to both business and family benefits may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-work-hours-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify daily work hours may fund faster.

female-pitch-length-faster.body: Significantly longer pitch text may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-age-contradiction.body: The effect of mentioning age in female pitches is contradictory, appearing in both faster and slower contexts.

female-environmental-protection-faster.body: Mentioning the promotion of environmental protection may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-location-specificity-faster.body: Mentioning a specific town, region, or ancestral traditions may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-skills-character-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly describe their skills or character traits may fund faster.

female-loan-history-faster.body: Mentioning previous loan history or a credit record may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-marital-status-slower.title: Mentioning marital status as married may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-marital-status-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop from puzzles to make room for new observations.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Pitches from women that focus on dreams, aspirations, or the goal of saving money tend to fund more slowly.
female-savings-dreams-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for new interaction claim due to claim cap.

female-previous-loans-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention having previous loans may fund more slowly.
female-previous-loans-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning previous loans correlates with faster funding for women.

female-high-loan-amount-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention higher loan amounts in their pitch text may fund more slowly.
female-high-loan-amount-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation.

male-loan-purpose-inventory-faster.title: For male borrowers, using the loan for business inventory may be faster than using it for education.
male-loan-purpose-inventory-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-household-deficits-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific personal or household deficits fund more slowly.
female-household-deficits-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-previous-loans-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention having previous loans may fund faster.
female-previous-loans-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning previous loans correlates with slower funding for women.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.title: The use of the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' in female pitches may predict faster funding.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new location observation.

female-general-store-faster.title: Mentioning a general store business may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-general-store-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observation on skills/character.

female-child-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children may fund faster.
female-child-count-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying exact number of children predicts slower funding.
